name: Sink
scene: A sink in its base cabinet or vanity: counter with the basin (built from walls or a lathe so the inside shows), faucet with spout, aerator and handle(s), and under it the drain tailpiece, P-trap to the wall, two shutoff valves on the back wall with supply lines up to the faucet. Cabinet floor, back wall and one side wall; front open.
size: Kitchen counter 0.9 m, bathroom vanity 0.8-0.85 m. Kitchen basin 0.45-0.8 x 0.4 m, 0.2 m deep; bathroom basin 0.4-0.5 m oval (lathe with stretch). P-trap 1.25-1.5 inch (0.035-0.04 m).

parts.label: Faucet
parts.describe: Chrome or finished faucet body and spout on the counter behind the basin.

parts.label: Faucet handle
parts.describe: Single lever on top or beside the spout, or two cross/lever handles; turns or lifts to run water.

parts.label: Aerator
parts.describe: Small screen cap screwed onto the spout tip; unscrews downward. Child of the spout, at its tip, axis pointing down out of the spout.

parts.label: Mineral buildup
parts.describe: Scale and grit in the aerator screen; child of the aerator.

parts.label: Drain stopper
parts.describe: Pop-up stopper (bathroom) or basket strainer (kitchen) in the drain; lifts out.

parts.label: Hair and gunk
parts.describe: Hair or food clog (clump with hair or food_scraps) on the stopper or in the trap.

parts.label: P-trap
parts.describe: U-bend under the tailpiece with slip nuts, running to the wall drain; drops down when the nuts are loosened.

parts.label: Slip nut
parts.describe: Nut at the top of the trap that unscrews by hand.

parts.label: Hot water valve
parts.describe: Shutoff valve on the back wall, left; normally open, clockwise closes.

parts.label: Cold water valve
parts.describe: Shutoff valve on the back wall, right; normally open.

parts.label: Supply lines
parts.describe: Braided hoses from the valves up to the faucet.

parts.label: Cabinet door
parts.describe: Front door of the base cabinet hinged at its left edge, shown open.

debris: hair clog on a bathroom pop-up stopper
a water puddle on the cabinet floor under a leak
views: front, low, at the spout tip for the aerator
notes: Kitchen: rectangular basin from walls; bathroom: oval lathe basin under the counter. Put a bucket (lathe) under the trap if the fix drains it.
